tools.name: cross_network_cultural_search
tools.description: Queries archival nodes across three distinct contemporary art and media research networks: NeMe (2,055 posts), A Sea Change (Mediterranean ecological art), and Toolkit of Care (critical support networks).

tools.name: generate_text_citation
tools.description: Generates a standardized Chicago Manual of Style citation for the current NeMe page.

format.description: The citation standard. NeMe strictly utilizes the Chicago Manual of Style.
